title: Add a component
description: Add a display to a system from the Simulation page, with a simulated device as its address, pick its credential, test it, and land on its collected values.

steps.caption: The lab's simulated devices. Adding one to monitor starts here, or from Explore's New menu, or a system's Components.
One flow, from the product to an endpoint that has answered. Nothing is created until the test.
Choose what it is. Products are found by name, type or vendor.
A Boreal Edge 55, a display. The platform names it from its type.
It fills the system's panel slot. Only the slots a display may fill are offered, and its location comes from the system.
Next, how the outpost reaches it.
The product's own driver is chosen, and a new simulated display fills in the outpost, its address and the driver's inputs.
The SNMP community is picked from the secrets of that kind, never typed. The simulator's is already chosen.
Create the component and its endpoint, and test them.
The outpost ran the driver's poll and shows what it read. A failure would name its cause and offer the step to fix.
Done. The new display opens on its Overview.
Its first values are already collected, with no detour to another page.
